tool_args.rationale: All pilot observations are positive and end by H = 0.48, far short of the forecast horizon of 21.6. The slow-horizon probe tests whether the response reverses and helps separate the slow adaptation amplitude from its time constant before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows mainly constrain the ratio of adaptation amplitude to slow time constant, not their separate effects at H = 21.6.
Finer short-horizon sampling does not directly test the predicted late reversal.
It does not resolve the slow adaptation ambiguity.
